title: NHS Trusts Face Funding Gaps for Maternity Leave
subtitle: New research shows that many physiotherapy teams lack the budget to replace staff during maternity leave, causing longer waits for patients.

summary.en: New data shows nearly half of NHS trusts in England do not have specific budgets to pay for maternity leave cover. This issue is particularly bad for physiotherapy departments, which are often treated worse than nursing teams. When staff go on leave without replacements, remaining workers must handle extra tasks. This leads to longer waiting times and worse care for patients who need rehabilitation. Experts are now calling on the government to fix these funding gaps and end hiring freezes.
summary.zh: 新數據顯示，英格蘭近半數的國民保健署信託機構沒有專門預算來支付產假替代人力。這個問題對物理治療部門尤為嚴重，他們受到的待遇往往比護理團隊更差。當員工請假而無人替補時，留守人員必須處理額外工作。這導致需要復健的病患等待時間變長且照護品質下降。專家們正呼籲政府填補這些資金缺口並終止凍結招募。

paragraphs.en: A new report has highlighted a serious problem within the National Health Service (NHS) in England. According to analysis by the Chartered Society of Physiotherapy (CSP), nearly half of all NHS trusts—the organizations that manage hospitals and local health services—do not have money set aside to pay for staff who take maternity leave. This means that when a staff member goes on leave to have a baby, there is often no budget to hire a temporary replacement.
paragraphs.zh: 一份新報告凸顯了英格蘭國民保健署（NHS）內部的嚴重問題。根據特許物理治療學會（CSP）的分析，近半數的國民保健署信託機構（即管理醫院與地方醫療服務的組織）並未預留經費來支付員工的產假薪資。這意味著當員工請產假去生小孩時，往往沒有預算可以聘請臨時替代人員。

paragraphs.en: The CSP gathered this information by sending freedom of information requests to various trusts. These requests allow the public to ask government organizations for official data. The results showed that 49% of the trusts they contacted had no dedicated budget or official policy to allow for overspending to pay for maternity cover. This lack of planning creates a difficult situation for the remaining staff, who must often take on the extra work of their absent colleagues.
paragraphs.zh: 特許物理治療學會透過向各個信託機構發送資訊自由請求來收集這些資訊。這些請求允許民眾向政府組織索取官方數據。結果顯示，他們聯繫的信託機構中，有百分之四十九沒有專門的預算或官方政策來允許超支以支付產假替代人力。這種缺乏規劃的情況為留守的員工帶來了困境，他們往往必須承擔缺席同事額外的工作量。

paragraphs.en: One of the most concerning findings is that physiotherapy staff seem to be treated less fairly than other healthcare workers. The analysis revealed that more than one in five trusts, or 22%, said their maternity cover arrangements did not include physiotherapy staff. In comparison, only 9% of trusts failed to provide this support for nursing posts. This difference is especially important because about 79% of the NHS physiotherapy workforce is made up of women, making maternity leave a common and predictable part of the career.
paragraphs.zh: 最令人擔憂的發現之一是，物理治療人員似乎受到了比其他醫療工作者更不公平的對待。分析顯示，超過五分之一（即百分之二十二）的信託機構表示，他們的產假替代人力安排並不包含物理治療人員。相較之下，僅有百分之九的信託機構未能為護理職位提供此類支援。這種差異尤為重要，因為國民保健署的物理治療人力中約有百分之七十九為女性，這使得產假成為職涯中常見且可預見的一部分。

paragraphs.en: Ash James, the director of practice and development at the CSP, expressed deep concern about these findings. He explained that when a physiotherapist goes on maternity leave, the patients who need treatment do not simply stop needing it. Without a replacement, the remaining team members are forced to work much harder to handle the extra load. This situation is made worse by current challenges in the NHS, such as recruitment freezes—periods where hospitals are not allowed to hire new staff—and a general lack of resources. Mr. James argued that trusts must ensure that maternity cover is available fairly across all clinical professions.
paragraphs.zh: 特許物理治療學會的執業與發展主任艾許·詹姆斯（Ash James）對這些發現深表關切。他解釋說，當物理治療師請產假時，需要治療的病患並不會因此就不再需要治療。在沒有替代人員的情況下，剩下的團隊成員被迫更加努力工作以應對額外負擔。國民保健署目前面臨的挑戰，例如凍結招募（即醫院不被允許聘請新員工的時期）以及資源普遍匱乏，使這種情況雪上加霜。詹姆斯先生主張，信託機構必須確保所有臨床專業都能公平地獲得產假替代人力。

paragraphs.en: This issue has direct consequences for the people who rely on the NHS. Alastair Henderson, the chair of the Patients’ Association, noted that when services are already stretched, losing staff without replacing them leads to problems for patients. He explained that these gaps can result in longer waits for treatment and rehabilitation, which is the process of helping a patient recover from an injury or illness. He also warned that patients might lose access to specialist expertise because the remaining teams are under too much pressure. According to Mr. Henderson, patients should not have to wait longer or miss out on necessary care simply because the NHS failed to plan for predictable staff absences.
paragraphs.zh: 這個問題對依賴國民保健署的民眾有直接影響。病患協會主席阿拉斯泰爾·韓德森（Alastair Henderson）指出，當醫療服務已經捉襟見肘時，失去員工卻不進行替補會導致病患面臨問題。他解釋說，這些人力缺口可能導致治療與復健（即協助病患從受傷或疾病中恢復的過程）的等待時間變長。他也警告，由於留守團隊承受過大壓力，病患可能會失去獲得專家專業協助的機會。根據韓德森先生的說法，病患不應僅因為國民保健署未能針對可預見的員工缺席進行規劃，就必須等待更久或錯失必要的照護。

paragraphs.en: This is not the only challenge facing physiotherapy services. Earlier research has suggested that patients who have suffered a stroke or other serious health issues are already receiving poorer care because hospitals often lack enough space and equipment. A survey of more than 2,000 CSP members found that four out of 10 physiotherapy staff had lost or expected to lose the space they used for rehabilitation. Six out of 10 members said their rooms had been taken over by other clinical teams. Many of these staff members blamed a lack of funding or managers who did not prioritize their work.
paragraphs.zh: 這並非物理治療服務面臨的唯一挑戰。先前的研究顯示，中風或其他嚴重健康問題的病患已經因為醫院常缺乏足夠空間與設備而接受較差的照護。一項針對超過兩千名特許物理治療學會成員的調查發現，十分之四的物理治療人員已經失去或預期將失去他們用於復健的空間。十分之六的成員表示他們的空間已被其他臨床團隊佔用。許多員工將此歸咎於缺乏資金，或是管理階層未將他們的工作列為優先事項。

paragraphs.en: The CSP is now calling for urgent action to address these problems. They want to see equal access to maternity cover funding for all NHS professions. Furthermore, they are asking the government to lift recruitment freezes and invest more in the physiotherapy workforce to ensure that patient care does not suffer. As the demand for healthcare continues to grow, the ability of the NHS to manage its staff effectively remains a critical issue for the future of the health service.
paragraphs.zh: 特許物理治療學會目前正呼籲採取緊急行動以解決這些問題。他們希望看到所有國民保健署專業都能平等地獲得產假替代人力的經費。此外，他們要求政府解除招募凍結，並增加對物理治療人力的投資，以確保病患照護品質不會受到影響。隨著醫療需求持續成長，國民保健署能否有效管理其員工，仍是該醫療服務未來發展的關鍵議題。

sources.title: Half of NHS trusts in England lack funds earmarked to cover maternity leave

quiz.question: According to the report, what is the primary reason that maternity leave creates a problem for NHS staff?

options.A: The government has banned all maternity leave for healthcare workers.
options.B: Many trusts lack a budget to hire temporary replacements for those on leave.
options.C: Physiotherapists are required to work from home while on maternity leave.
options.D: The NHS trusts do not have enough office space to accommodate new staff.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章第一段與第二段明確指出，近半數的 NHS 信託機構沒有編列預算來支付產假期間的薪資或聘請臨時替代人員。選項 A 錯誤，文中並未提到禁止產假；選項 C 與文章內容無關；選項 D 雖然在第六段提到空間問題，但與產假預算導致的人手短缺無直接因果關係。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the impact of the current maternity cover policies on the NHS workforce?

options.A: Nursing staff are more likely to face maternity cover shortages than physiotherapy staff.
options.B: Physiotherapy departments are prioritized by managers over other clinical teams.
options.C: The lack of planning disproportionately affects female-dominated professions within the NHS.
options.D: Recruitment freezes are the only reason why physiotherapists are struggling to find work.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第三段指出，22% 的信託機構不提供物理治療師產假保障，遠高於護理人員的 9%。由於該領域 79% 為女性，且產假是可預期的職涯規劃，這顯示出該政策對女性比例高的職業造成了不公平的影響。選項 A 與文意相反；選項 B 錯誤，文中提到物理治療師常被邊緣化；選項 D 錯誤，招聘凍結只是加劇問題的因素之一，而非唯一原因。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, what does the word 'stretched' mean in the context of NHS services?

options.A: Physically expanded to cover more geographical areas.
options.B: Operating under pressure with limited resources and high demand.
options.C: Reaching out to new patients to increase the number of clients.
options.D: Improving the flexibility of staff schedules to benefit patients.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在此語境下，「stretched」形容醫療服務因資源不足、人員短缺卻需求龐大，導致運作瀕臨極限。選項 A 是字面意思的誤解；選項 C 與文中描述的服務品質下降不符；選項 D 將該詞誤解為正向的彈性調整，與原文強調的壓力與負面後果背道而馳。

quiz.question: What is the central message of the article regarding the NHS and physiotherapy services?

options.A: Physiotherapy is becoming an obsolete profession within the modern healthcare system.
options.B: The NHS is successfully managing staff absences through effective long-term planning.
options.C: Patients prefer to wait longer for treatment rather than see temporary staff.
options.D: Inadequate funding and poor planning for staff absences are negatively impacting patient care.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。本文主旨旨在探討 NHS 在產假規劃上的預算缺失，以及此問題如何導致人手不足、增加現有員工壓力，進而損害病患權益（如治療延誤）。選項 A 與文意不符；選項 B 與文章強調的「缺乏規劃」事實相反；選項 C 在文中並未提及，且不符合病患利益。
